tagline: The full rules of Josh McCrowell's game of guild-mates delving the Underworld — searchable, deep-linkable, and ready for the table.
blurb: A Silver ENNIE winner — Best Game and Best Rules. Tarot cards drive tests and combat; food, light, and friendship keep you alive. This reference carries the book's open game text; the art, maps, and tutorial dungeon live in the book itself.
